pages.text: $(bold)Not available on this Minecraft version.$() Randomized librarians need a villager-trade registry that 1.21.1 does not have, so the datapack is not registered here.$(br2)On later versions, librarians sell an $(#7A2FBF)enchanted book with a random tradeable enchantment$() each purchase instead of one fixed book for the rest of the villager's life.

When the module exists, the trade still costs emeralds plus a plain book and follows vanilla librarian tier pricing.$(br2)$(li)Novice: 15 emeralds, 1 use$(li)Apprentice: 18 emeralds, 1 use$(li)Journeyman: 20 emeralds, 2 uses$(li)Expert: 24 emeralds, 3 uses$(br2)It pairs well with $(l:penchant:modules/loot_rework)Loot Rework$(/l) so villagers stay a source of discovery rather than a checklist.
